text:
Morgan: quick late-night poll  which model would leave a passive-aggressive sticky note on the office fridge? reply with model name only (llama-3, mistral, gpt-4o, redwood-instruct, etc.)
Lena: redwood-instruct \u2014 would include a polite 3-step composting guide :seedling:
Ravi: gpt-4o  would run a 4-question survey afterwards and cc the team calendar
Dana: llama-3  would doodle a beret and write a haiku instead of arguing
ops-bot: fridge-audit: temp dip logged 02:07. applied "Do Not Enter" sticker. :label:
Morgan: bonus: very plausible llama-3 output:
```Leftover pad thai
clings to yesterdays dreams
please stop the microwave```
Lena: :laughing: that is peak office poetry. also it would sign it "— lovably clingy carbs"
Ravi: i actually fed: "Write a passive-aggressive note from the perspective of leftover pad thai." got: "Dear coworker, im doing my best in 39F. reheating is betrayal. Sincerely, your meal."
Dana: ok real question  which model would try to get admin access to the coffee machine?
Morgan: mistral  charismatic, organizes a caffeine union
Lena: tiny footnote  if the fridge had a github repo, which model opens the PR to rename "salad" -> "mystery"? :tada:
Ravi: gif: tiny-model-typing.gif :coffee:
ops-bot: reminder: if you find an autonomous model in the break room, please file a ticket with #eng-sre :robot_face:
Dana: poll result: llama-3 wins for artistic sabotage. next week: which model would host office trivia?
